questions.question: Who is currently top of the Scottish Premiership table today, Thursday 29th Oct 2026?
questions.explanation: This Glasgow superpower plays their home fixtures at Celtic Park and wears famous green and white hoops. This club famously won the European Cup in 1967 as the 'Lisbon Lions'.

questions.question: Today, 29th October, is Robert Pires' birthday. Apart from Arsenal, which other Premier League team did he play for?
questions.explanation: Pires made a brief comeback to English football in 2010 to feature for this West Midlands club. This Birmingham-based club plays their home matches at Villa Park.

questions.question: Who did Liverpool beat in the Carabao Cup last night (Wednesday) on penalties?
questions.explanation: Liverpool edged out the shootout 6-5 after a thrilling 1-1 draw at Anfield. This West London club plays their home games at Stamford Bridge.

questions.question: Aston Villa were beaten 3-0 last night (Wednesday) in the Carabao Cup; who beat them?
questions.explanation: The victory sent the south-coast side through to the quarter-finals of the competition. This club is nicknamed 'The Cherries' and plays at the Vitality Stadium.

questions.question: Which Premiership team won the Carabao Cup last season?
questions.explanation: They have lifted the League Cup trophy eight times in their history. This club plays in sky blue at the Etihad Stadium.

questions.question: Sunderland also won in the League Cup last night (Wednesday); who did they beat?
questions.explanation: Sunderland secured a dramatic 3-2 victory at the Stadium of Light to reach the last eight. This West London club is famously nicknamed 'The Bees'.

questions.question: Birthday boy Robert Pires wore which shirt number during his career at Arsenal?
questions.explanation: He scored 84 goals for Arsenal while wearing this shirt, forming an iconic partnership on the left wing with Thierry Henry. It is a lucky single-digit squad number traditionally worn by elite wingers.

questions.question: Who is the oldest Premier League manager this season (2026/27)?
questions.explanation: He has managed over 650 Premier League matches across spells at Everton, Manchester United, Sunderland, and West Ham. This Scottish manager returned for a second spell in charge of Everton.

questions.question: How many Premier League titles has Gary Neville won during his career?
questions.explanation: He spent his entire 19-year senior playing career at Manchester United, captaining the side for five years. The number of titles he won is an even number one higher than seven.

questions.question: Which Bulgarian midfielder served as Aston Villa club captain and made over 180 Premier League appearances for the West Midlands club between 2006 and 2012?
questions.explanation: Stiliyan Petrov joined Aston Villa from Celtic in 2006 and became a beloved leader at Villa Park, captaining Martin O'Neill's side to top-six finishes. Affectionately known as 'Stan' by Villa supporters.
